_doc: Hand-shaped skirmish maps (FEATURES 6.7): generator presets. Thresholds are on 0..1024 noise: lower 'lake' = fewer lakes, lower 'forest' = more forest, 'bog' higher = more bog. 'relief' is hill height in mm. 'hotspots' = contaminated pockets; 'plant_center' puts the plant in the middle of the map.

border_corridor.name: The Border Corridor
border_corridor.text: A long road valley between two forest belts. Depots sit on the road; the plant looms to the north.

red_forest.name: Red Forest
red_forest.text: Dense, contaminated woodland. Short sight lines, hot pockets everywhere, bogs on the low ground.

kaarnavaara.name: Kaarnavaara
kaarnavaara.text: The plant itself in the middle of the map, ringed by lakes. Whoever holds the centre takes the dose.
